title: A Survey on Optimal Transport for Machine Learning: Theory and Applications
tldr_zh: 面向 ML 读者的 OT 入门综述，覆盖历史、对偶/熵正则数学预备与五类应用，无新理论或新实验。
tldr_en: An application-focused OT survey for ML readers covering history, duality/entropic regularization math prerequisites, and five application areas; no new theory or experiments.

key_numbers.context: semantic correspondence PCK improvement over SOTA reported by Liu et al.
